subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about retained D7 volume for your casual titles. Since North American gaming CPI rose 31% year over year to $1.68 in 2025, and US casual iOS installs now run roughly $1.50 to $3.50, the cheap-install math the way Voodoo and Azur Games play it gets punished fast unless the D7 cohort actually monetizes. That is where retention-tuned buying earns its keep, and we hold out a control group so the paid cohort reads as incremental to your organic players. Want to compare against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: 2025 NA gaming CPI +31% to $1.68 (sourced) + US casual iOS CPI band $1.50-$3.50
